title: SentinelCI remediation attempt v1
description: One attempt of the remediation loop (A6, SPEC section 9): the patch proposal, its verification result, and the repository it was made for. What `sentinel upload-remediation` sends to the platform (`POST /api/v1/remediations`) for the Remediation page and `sentinel_remediation_attempts_total`. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, checked by the producer and the platform: the result is the proposal's (the same proposal_id and attempt), and it was not verified before the proposal was made.

repo.description: The repository the proposal was made for, owner/name.
